answer: Retirement accounts can be grouped by how they are opened: employer-sponsored plans include options such as 401(k), 403(b), and 457(b) plans, while individual retirement accounts (IRAs) can be opened by you at a vendor of your choice. Depending on your circumstances, you may have more than one type of retirement account. These accounts may offer tax benefits, such as deductions, tax-deferred growth, or tax-free withdrawals.
